sents.zh: 将该智能体与现有能力相结合，能让社群在不自行开发完整通用助手的情况下，塑造一个功能全面的系统。

sents.en: Our experiments illustrate how a single complementary agent can add targeted capability to a shared system.
sents.zh: 我们的实验表明，单个互补智能体如何能为共享系统增添特定的能力。

sents.en: On GAIA, adding an agent with 19% standalone accuracy raises an existing MDA’s accuracy from 40% to 53% ( Fig. 5(c) ).
sents.zh: 在 GAIA 上，添加一个独立准确率为 19% 的智能体，可将现有 MDA 的准确率从 40% 提升至 53%（图 5(c)）。

sents.en: Diverse stakeholders could thus influence the capabilities of shared AI systems through what they build and deploy, democratizing development priorities beyond those of the largest providers.
sents.zh: 因此，多样化的利益相关者可以通过他们构建和部署的内容来影响共享人工智能系统的能力，从而将开发优先级民主化，超越最大提供商的主导地位。

paragraphs.en: Our work is a starting point for this line of inquiry and many open questions remain. We show that coordination overheads of MDAs can offset theoretical gains and that their practicality depends on the task. It is unlikely that an MDA is superior to SDAs in all settings. Additional challenges require addressing, including how routing and decomposition/composition will be implemented at scale. Dividing value between collaborating agents and deciding who will bear the cost of running shared MDA infrastructure remain open problems.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的工作为这一研究方向提供了一个起点，但仍有许多问题悬而未决。 我们表明，MDA 的协调开销可能会抵消其理论上的优势，而其实用性则取决于具体任务。 MDA 在所有场景中都优于 SDA 的可能性不大。 还需要应对更多挑战，包括如何在大规模环境中实现路由以及分解/组合机制。 如何在协作智能体之间分配价值，以及由谁来承担共享 MDA 基础设施的运行成本，仍然是尚未解决的问题。

sents.en: Our work is a starting point for this line of inquiry and many open questions remain.
sents.zh: 我们的工作为这一研究方向提供了一个起点，但仍有许多问题悬而未决。

sents.en: We show that coordination overheads of MDAs can offset theoretical gains and that their practicality depends on the task.
sents.zh: 我们表明，MDA 的协调开销可能会抵消其理论上的优势，而其实用性则取决于具体任务。

sents.en: It is unlikely that an MDA is superior to SDAs in all settings.
sents.zh: MDA 在所有场景中都优于 SDA 的可能性不大。

sents.en: Additional challenges require addressing, including how routing and decomposition/composition will be implemented at scale.
sents.zh: 还需要应对更多挑战，包括如何在大规模环境中实现路由以及分解/组合机制。

sents.en: Dividing value between collaborating agents and deciding who will bear the cost of running shared MDA infrastructure remain open problems.
sents.zh: 如何在协作智能体之间分配价值，以及由谁来承担共享 MDA 基础设施的运行成本，仍然是尚未解决的问题。

paragraphs.en: Furthermore, security, privacy, and accountability challenges are amplified under MDAs where not all participants can be trusted. Robust measures will need to be put in place to ensure a single malicious or poorly performing system cannot cause catastrophic downstream consequences. Our δ \delta -MDA is only a preliminary step towards addressing some of the unique challenges of a multi-developer system. We anticipate better coordination mechanisms and MDA designs will follow.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，在并非所有参与者都可被信任的多智能体代理（MDA）系统中，安全性、隐私性和问责性的挑战会被进一步放大。 必须采取强有力的措施，确保单个恶意或表现不佳的系统不会引发灾难性的后续后果。 我们的 δ \delta -MDA 仅仅是应对多开发者系统所面临的一些独特挑战的初步步骤。 我们预计，未来将出现更完善的协调机制和 MDA 设计。

sents.en: Furthermore, security, privacy, and accountability challenges are amplified under MDAs where not all participants can be trusted.
sents.zh: 此外，在并非所有参与者都可被信任的多智能体代理（MDA）系统中，安全性、隐私性和问责性的挑战会被进一步放大。

sents.en: Robust measures will need to be put in place to ensure a single malicious or poorly performing system cannot cause catastrophic downstream consequences.
sents.zh: 必须采取强有力的措施，确保单个恶意或表现不佳的系统不会引发灾难性的后续后果。

sents.en: Our δ \delta -MDA is only a preliminary step towards addressing some of the unique challenges of a multi-developer system.
sents.zh: 我们的 δ \delta -MDA 仅仅是应对多开发者系统所面临的一些独特挑战的初步步骤。

sents.en: We anticipate better coordination mechanisms and MDA designs will follow.
sents.zh: 我们预计，未来将出现更完善的协调机制和 MDA 设计。

paragraphs.en: No theoretical or empirical models can perfectly capture the complex dynamics of a real population of developers deploying agents into a collective system. The real test for MDAs will be when they are realized in the wild. When they are, we believe they will enable a diverse population of developers to collectively scale a dynamic, evolving system of intelligence whose capabilities far exceed the reach of any single developer. We hope this work is a step towards realizing such a vision.
paragraphs.zh: 没有任何理论或经验模型能够完美捕捉到真实开发者群体在将智能体部署到集体系统中时所呈现出的复杂动态。 MDA 的真正考验，将在它们于现实环境中得以实现之时到来。 届时我们相信，它们将使多样化的开发者群体能够共同扩展一个动态演化的智能系统，其能力将远超任何单个开发者的能力范围。 我们希望这项工作能为实现这一愿景迈出一小步。

paragraphs.en: Our constraint ∑ d q d 2 ≤ b i 2 \sum_{d}q_{d}^{2}\leq b_{i}^{2} models diminishing returns: each additional unit of capability costs more development effort. This is plausible for agentic AI, where further gains in an already capable system can require substantially more data, computation, and engineering effort. paragraphs.zh: 我们的约束条件 ∑ d q d 2 ≤ b i 2 \sum_{d}q_{d}^{2}\leq b_{i}^{2} 体现了收益递减规律：每增加一单位能力，所需的发展投入都会更多。 对于智能体型人工智能而言，这一点是合理的，因为一个已经具备能力的系统若想获得进一步的提升，可能需要投入更多的数据、计算资源和工程努力。 这种二次形式是对该权衡关系的一种风格化表达。 而线性约束 ∑ d q d ≤ b i \sum_{d}q_{d}\leq b_{i} 则假设每单位能力的成本是恒定的，并且即使在流量份额补偿的情况下，也能支持专业化发展。 因此，命题 5 中关于普遍性的结论取决于所假设的发展成本。 引理 3 中关于固定资源池的福利比较并未使用预算约束，因此在两种假设下都仍然有效。

paragraphs.en: The common skill space and linear capability map are stylized models of development. They omit developer-specific production technologies, fixed costs, and tasks whose success depends on a bottleneck skill. The welfare comparison also assumes additive contributions and omits the costs of decomposition, communication, and composition. These costs can offset the gain from combining specialists, as the empirical comparisons in §​​ 5 illustrate.
paragraphs.zh: 通用技能空间与线性能力图谱是对发展过程的风格化模型。 它们忽略了开发者特有的生产技术、固定成本，以及成功取决于瓶颈技能的任务。 福利比较还假设了可加性贡献，并忽略了分解、沟通和组合所产生的成本。 正如第 5 节中的实证比较所示，这些成本可能会抵消结合专家所带来的收益。

In particular, the generalist δ \delta -MDA equilibrium shows that supporting specialization does not guarantee convergence to a specialist pool.

paragraphs.en: Interactions between the router and the agent pool are stored in a buffer ℬ \mathcal{B} , where each item consists of the input and output of a single subtask, and ground truth labels. During the training phase, we track the number of requests sent to each system in the pool and prompt the σ \sigma -agent to prefer systems with lower request counts to ensure balanced exploration. Routers are always trained for their target coordination mechanism, since the distribution of inputs will differ. In other words, the router is trained separately for the rSDA and δ \delta -MDA.

paragraphs.en: The subtasks in ℬ \mathcal{B} are grouped into clusters 𝒞 j ⊆ ℬ \mathcal{C}_{j}\subseteq\mathcal{B} based on their parent task. Since the update agent only has task level ground truth, for the δ \delta -MDA it must infer the correctness of intermediate results. For GAIA, we provide human annotator metadata that includes subtask breakdown, and in SealQA where this is not available, we use the task answer only. paragraphs.en: In general, downstream agent quality did not appear to correlate with the meta-agent LLM. These results suggest that the tier of the agent has meaningful connections to the capabilities of the underlying system, and support our economic analogy to under-resourced developers.

paragraphs.en: In step-0, the router forwarded 100% of document-analysis requests to D4-M . After learning that its description overstated its capabilities, the router sent it fewer than 20% of these requests. Developers may overstate their systems’ capabilities, so MDAs need to learn from experience across independently developed agents. The Wikipedia-analysis agent W2-M has the same configuration as D4-M except for its specification, yet the router prefers it over similar systems. These results highlight the differences between MDAs, where learning between multiple competing agents is critical, and traditional MAS, where control over agent composition is often implicit.
paragraphs.zh: 在第 0 步中，路由器将 100% 的文件分析请求转发给了 D4-M。 在了解到自己的描述夸大了其能力之后，路由器向其发送了不到 20% 的这些请求。 开发者可能会夸大其系统的能力，因此 MDA 需要从独立开发的多个智能体之间的经验中学习。 Wikipedia 分析智能体 W2-M 的配置与 D4-M 相同，除了其规格不同之外，但路由器仍更倾向于选择它而非类似系统。 这些结果凸显了 MDA 与传统 MAS 之间的差异：在 MDA 中，多个相互竞争的智能体之间的学习至关重要；而在传统 MAS 中，对智能体构成的控制通常是隐性的。

sents.zh: 在了解到自己的描述夸大了其能力之后，路由器向其发送了不到 20% 的这些请求。

sents.en: Developers may overstate their systems’ capabilities, so MDAs need to learn from experience across independently developed agents.

sents.en: These results highlight the differences between MDAs, where learning between multiple competing agents is critical, and traditional MAS, where control over agent composition is often implicit.
sents.zh: 这些结果凸显了 MDA 与传统 MAS 之间的差异：在 MDA 中，多个相互竞争的智能体之间的学习至关重要；而在传统 MAS 中，对智能体构成的控制通常是隐性的。

paragraphs.en: Developers using high-tier backbones, gpt-5.2 with low reasoning, did not always dominate developers using weaker models. In step-2, the low-tier agent A1-L , powered by gpt-5-mini with low reasoning, received more traffic than all other data-analysis systems, including high-tier agents. The same phenomenon also emerged for Wikipedia-analyst systems, in which some medium-tier agents were selected consistently over high-tier systems. These differences emerge from the difference in the quality of the tools and system message written by the meta-agent in the production step and suggest that small, under-resourced developers using weaker models can nonetheless offer valuable capability in a δ \delta -MDA filled with stronger developers. The key is being able to identify and leverage these advantages between developers, as our transfer experiments in §​​ 5 demonstrate.
paragraphs.zh: 使用高级骨干模型且推理能力较弱的 gpt-5.2 的开发者，并不总能战胜使用较弱模型的开发者。 在步骤 2 中，由推理能力较弱的 gpt-5-mini 驱动的低级智能体 A1-L 获得了比其他所有数据分析系统（包括高级智能体）更多的流量。 维基百科分析系统中也出现了类似现象：一些中级智能体被持续优先选中，而非高级系统。 这些差异源于元智能体在生产阶段所编写的工具和系统提示词质量的不同，表明即使使用较弱模型的小型、资源不足的开发者，在充满更强开发者的 δ \delta -MDA 中，依然能够提供有价值的功能。 关键在于能够识别并利用开发者之间的这些优势，正如我们在 §5 的迁移实验中展示的那样。

sents.en: Developers using high-tier backbones, gpt-5.2 with low reasoning, did not always dominate developers using weaker models.
sents.zh: 使用高级骨干模型且推理能力较弱的 gpt-5.2 的开发者，并不总能战胜使用较弱模型的开发者。

sents.en: In step-2, the low-tier agent A1-L , powered by gpt-5-mini with low reasoning, received more traffic than all other data-analysis systems, including high-tier agents.
sents.zh: 在步骤 2 中，由推理能力较弱的 gpt-5-mini 驱动的低级智能体 A1-L 获得了比其他所有数据分析系统（包括高级智能体）更多的流量。

sents.en: The same phenomenon also emerged for Wikipedia-analyst systems, in which some medium-tier agents were selected consistently over high-tier systems.
sents.zh: 维基百科分析系统中也出现了类似现象：一些中级智能体被持续优先选中，而非高级系统。

sents.en: These differences emerge from the difference in the quality of the tools and system message written by the meta-agent in the production step and suggest that small, under-resourced developers using weaker models can nonetheless offer valuable capability in a δ \delta -MDA filled with stronger developers.
sents.zh: 这些差异源于元智能体在生产阶段所编写的工具和系统提示词质量的不同，表明即使使用较弱模型的小型、资源不足的开发者，在充满更强开发者的 δ \delta -MDA 中，依然能够提供有价值的功能。

sents.en: The key is being able to identify and leverage these advantages between developers, as our transfer experiments in §​​ 5 demonstrate.
sents.zh: 关键在于能够识别并利用开发者之间的这些优势，正如我们在 §5 的迁移实验中展示的那样。

paragraphs.en: In Fig. 8(b) , we empirically validate the theoretical equilibrium in Prop. 1 . We start with A 𝖦 A_{\mathsf{G}} under a routed-SDA and test replacing a single generalist SDA with a specialist SDA. This simulates a developer changing strategies under the theoretical Nash equilibrium. Under both the Tullock rule in Eq. 4 and a learned router, each specialist replacement receives less traffic than the original generalist. The extent to which the specialist is comparable depends on how broadly useful the specialist is. The web-search agent is able to recover up to 94% and 63% of original traffic under a Tullock contest and σ \sigma -agent respectively. In contrast, the math specialist only recovers 21% and 13% respectively. These results provide some empirical grounding for the theoretical results that switching from a generalist system to specialized ones is not advantageous under certain coordination mechanisms, such as a routed-SDA.

paragraphs.en: To further investigate the different effects of our design, we ablate various components of the δ \delta -MDA over A 𝖲 A_{\mathsf{S}} on GAIA in Tab. 1 . Replacing the σ \sigma -agent with a δ ​ γ \delta\gamma -agent that selects from agent descriptions alone drops accuracy by 7.8 7.8 pp. An untrained σ \sigma -agent is 1.3 1.3 pp below the no- σ \sigma baseline since it adds friction. After learning, global rankings recover 2.6 2.6 pp and contextual rankings recover the full 7.8 7.8 pp. This matters in deployment because meta-agents (and developers) write self-promoting descriptions, and only learned experience reveals each agent’s real strengths. The large marginal benefit of contextual information indicates that no single agent dominates uniformly. Furthermore, a strong δ ​ γ \delta\gamma component is also critical: a weak δ ​ γ \delta\gamma -agent ( gpt-4o-mini instead of gpt-5 ) drops performance by 14pp, and removing ground-truth labels from σ \sigma training drops it by 3.9pp since without ground truth the σ \sigma -agent cannot always distinguish a correct response from a confidently hallucinated one. In practice, a real MDA deployment would accumulate orders of magnitude more data that may be used to improve the router.
paragraphs.zh: 为了进一步研究我们设计的不同效应，我们在表 1 中通过移除 δ \delta -MDA 在 A 𝖲 A_{\mathsf{S}} 上的各种组件，在 GAIA 上进行了消融分析。 将 σ \sigma -智能体替换为仅根据智能体描述进行选择的 δ ​ γ \delta\gamma -智能体，会使准确率下降 7.8 7.8 pp。 未经训练的 σ \sigma -智能体的表现比无 σ \sigma 基线低 1.3 1.3 pp，因为它增加了摩擦。 学习后，全局排名恢复了 2.6 2.6 pp，而上下文排名则完全恢复了 7.8 7.8 pp。 这一点在实际部署中很重要，因为元智能体（以及开发者）会编写自我宣传的描述，而只有经过学习的经验才能揭示每个智能体的真实优势。 上下文信息带来的巨大边际效益表明，没有任何一个智能体能始终占据主导地位。 此外，一个强大的 δ ​ γ \delta\gamma 组件也至关重要：较弱的 δ ​ γ \delta\gamma -智能体（使用 gpt-4o-mini 而非 gpt-5）会使性能下降 14pp；而从 σ \sigma 训练中移除真实标签则会使性能下降 3.9pp，因为如果没有真实标签，σ \sigma -智能体就无法始终区分正确响应与自信生成的幻觉响应。 在实际应用中，真实的 MDA 部署会积累数量级更多的数据，这些数据可用于改进路由器。
